authorization: 2026-11-14用户明确给出11小时自主探索预算，并确认仅RL项目
scope: ME2502 ChemGPT molecular RL; separate extension, original18-run comparison immutable
ordering: Complete task-seed treatment blocks in phase priority order. Stop at absolute deadline; unrun cases listed, never scored zero. No selection using extension outcomes.

phases.name: kl_dose
phases.purpose: Independent replication and KL dose-response after seeing original main results; new cohort, not retrospective preregistration of original study.

phases.name: mechanism
phases.purpose: Prospective follow-up interventions informed by original case analysis. Distinguish KL from explicit per-action cost; explore task reward incompleteness. Original MPO always reported separately.

phases.name: long_budget
phases.purpose: Larger fixed evaluation budgets, new seeds; examine continuing improvement or concentration. Do not pool with 3000-query study as the same protocol.

training_objective: E[raw_MPO*TPSA_factor - length_cost*action_count] - beta*trajectory_KL. TPSA_factor=exp(-.5*(max(TPSA-upper_tpsa,0)/sigma)^2) only in upper_tpsa condition; not a drug-quality claim.
reporting: Raw-MPO discovery AUC and terminal raw-MPO reward are always retained; report transformed objective reward, validity, repeat, length, MW, TPSA and fixed-prior drift. Changed objectives are interventions, not silent improvements to the original task.
statistical_unit: independent training seed; matched treatment contrasts within phase/task/seed; report all planned conditions and failures
gates: Lengths and transformed rewards verified against hand-calculated examples
export: Export source/config and every completed run's JSON/JSONL; checkpoints retained in own AFS directory. Hold worker <=120s at end for final collection, included in deadline.
